item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 03/Aug/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An active southwest monsoon and upper-air disturbances will bring heavy showers and squally thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong persistently in the next couple of days. With the southwest monsoon moderating and an anticyclone aloft strengthening gradually, showers will ease off over the coastal areas of southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. The weather will become very hot.

Date/Month: 04/08 (Monday)
Wind: Southwest force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Cloudy with showers. Showers will be heavy at times with squally thunderstorms.
Temp range: 26 - 29 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High

Date/Month: 05/08 (Tuesday)
Wind: Southwest force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 on high ground.
Weather: Cloudy with showers and squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times.
